opening.argument: The presentation discusses a financial-system update and the future of money, while its description expressly frames the material as informational. A terminal-style frame depicts system-upgrade processing, but the reference to a Coinbase wallet/NFT URL is not accompanied by a described request to transfer funds, provide credentials, or complete a transaction. The separate subscription request is ordinary audience engagement. Taken together, these are features of a stylized discussion about financial technology, not evidence of a transactional solicitation.
